Rewrote each docstring with 'Test-only' as the first sentence; docs now redirect production backends to the corresponding SieveBackend trait methods.

The bead only named set_max_sieve_script_bytes, but set_max_sieve_scripts_per_account had the exact same shape and same defect — applied the fix to both atomically rather than leaving a follow-up bead.

Did NOT rename to set_*_for_test (chat-server convention). The chat-server canonical uses _for_test suffix; mail-server's set_* names predate that convention. Renaming would be a pre-1.0 break with no semantic gain; #[doc(hidden)] is sufficient to address the actual concern (consumers reading cargo doc and mistaking these for recommended configuration knobs).

Cookie-cutter posture: chat-server already has #[doc(hidden)] on all three of its set_*_for_test knobs (verified via grep). No sibling extension-server propagation needed. Calendars/contacts/tasks/filenode/metadata/sharing memory backends checked — no analogous publicly-exposed test knobs found.

Quality gates: fmt + clippy --all-features --tests + test --all-features + doc --features memory,sieve all clean. All 23 sieve_integration tests pass.
